scientific_integrity: The finite-graph relative spanning-tree equivalence and loop-coordinate cellular splitting are established over the integers; the cited tree theorem supplies integral homology. Theorem records explicit first Betti and anchors assumptions and extreme cases. No independent validation has been carried out.
scientific_limitations: Fully anchored labeled configurations with collisions permitted only; not collision-free graph braid spaces, partial anchors, unordered quotients, homotopy or cohomology-ring classification. The integer theorem is proved using the tree homotopy result; mod-two finite checks are consistency tests, not an infinite proof.
title: Integral homology of anchored configurations on every connected graph
